english.title: Without reasonable excuse, fail to comply with a requirement imposed by a constable to ground an unmanned aircraft

english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 1(3) and (4) of Schedule 8 to the Air Traffic Management and Unmanned Aircraft Act 2021.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure

english.notes:
(i) Paragraph 1(3) of Schedule 8 specifies that, in order for this offence to be committed, the person must be in control of the unmanned aircraft and lack a reasonable excuse for failing to comply with the requirement. This may mean that in a situation where the unmanned aircraft technology has been hacked or malfunctioned, for example, the person would not be guilty of an offence.
(ii) The 'NPCC Counter Drones Team' supports and co-ordinates counter drones activity across UK policing. For advice and support from this team, please email Drones.Secretariat@met.police.uk.
